test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.

The rodeo is (great way to unite soldier's skills and build) esprit de corps.

options.text: a great way to unite soldiers' skills and build
great way to unite soldier's skills and building
a great way to unite an soldier's skill and build

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **most appropriate option** to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence is: "a great way to unite soldiers' skills and build"
 
• The original sentence is missing the indefinite article **"a"** before** "great way". **
 
• Also**, "soldier's skills" **would imply that the skills belong to one soldier.
 
• However, in the context of the sentence, it's likely that we're talking about the skills of multiple soldiers, so **"soldiers' skills" **is the correct possessive form.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'The rodeo is a great way to unite soldiers' skills and build esprit de corps.*
